BiblicalUsage: Pildash is named once, in Genesis 22:22, as one of the eight sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by Milcah. His name means flame of fire, and his line is recorded in the same breath as Bethuel, the father of Rebekah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts the branches of the family even when their stories are never told.
